title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition
summary: Karen Simonyan and Andrew Zisserman submitted Very Deep Convolutional Networks for Large-Scale Image Recognition to arXiv on 4 September 2014. The paper evaluates convolutional networks of increasing depth using very small 3×3 convolution filters and reports configurations with 16 to 19 weight layers for large-scale image recognition.
significance: A documented deep-convolutional-network research milestone centered on systematic evaluation of increased network depth for large-scale image recognition.
organizations: Visual Geometry Group, University of Oxford
